Thank you for the conversation. It was helpful to hear that six fee earners spend about four hours each per week checking incoming packs.

As discussed, I understand you'll send ten anonymised sample packs by Friday. Once I receive them, I will return a bounded pilot outline along with our security questions within three business days.

Idris

Best regards,
Idris
